desc.en: The honourable Sayyid, Ali bin Taoos narrates the following supplication for the eighteenth day of the holy month of Ramadan…
desc.rurdu: 18th Ramazan ke din mein Imam Zamaan (a) ke zahoor ki dua padhe…
desc.urdu: ۱۸؍ ماہِ رمضان کے دن میں امام زمانہؑ کے ظہور کی دُعا پڑھے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ الظَّلَمَۃَ كَفَرُوْا بِكِتَابِكَ، وَحَجَدُوْا آیَاتِكَ، وَكَذَّبُوْا رُسُلَكَ، وَبَدَّلُوْا مَا جَائَبِهٖ رَسُوْلُكَ، وَشَرَعُوْا غَیْرَ دِیْنِكَ، سَعَوْا بِالْفَسَادِ فِیْ اَرْضِكَ، وَتَعَاوَنُوْا عَلٰی اِطْفَائِ نُوْرِكَ، وَشَاقُّوْا وُلَاۃَ اَمْرِكَ، وَ وَالَوْ اَعْدَائَكَ، وَعَادَوْا اَوْلِیَئَكَ، وَظَلَمُوْا اَهْلَ بَیْتِ نَبِیِّكَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, the transgressors have disbelieved in Your book, and denied You proofs, and falsified Your Prophets, and altered that which was brought by Your Messengers, and accepted another religion, and strived to establish corruption on earth, and aided each other to put off Your Light, and envied the Guardians of Your issues, and befriended Your enemies, and envied Your friends, and oppressed the household of Your Prophet.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَانْتَقِمْ مِنْهُمْ، وَاصْبُبْ عَلَیْهِمْ عَذَابَكَ، وَاسْتَاصِلْ شَافَتَهُمْ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوْا دِیْنِكَ دَغَلًا، وَمَالَكَ دُوَلًا، وَعِبَادَكَ خَوَلًا، فَاكْفُفْ بَاسَهُمْ، وَاَوْهِنْ كَیْدَهُمْ، وَاشْفِ مِنْهُمْ صُدُوْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَخَالِفْ بَیْنَ قُلُوْبِهِمْ، شَتِّتْ اَمْرَهُمْ، وَاجْعَلْ بَاسَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ، وَاسْفِكْ بِاَیْدِیْ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ دِمَائَهُمْ، وَخُذْهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, take revenge from them, and send down Your torment upon them, and uproot their foundation. O Allah, they took Your religion as a source of deceit and schemes, and occupied Your wealth with dominance, and made Your slaves their own, thus protect Your slaves from their evil, and weaken their schemes, and cure the chest of the believers amongst them, and create differences between them, and disorient their issues, and place their evil between them, and shed their blood by the hands of the believers, and punish them such that they don t understand the source of their entanglement.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنَّا نَشْهَدُ یَوْمَ الْقَیَامَۃِ، وَیَوْمَ حُلُوْلِ الطَّامَّۃِ، اَنَّهُمْ لَمْ یُذْنِبُوْا لَكَ ذَنْبًا، وَلَمْ یَرْتَكِبُوْا لَكَ مَعْصِیَۃً، وَلَمْ یُضَیِّعُوْا لَكَ طَاعَۃً، وَاَنَّ مَوْلَانَا سَیَّدَنَا صَحِبَ الزَّمَانِ، اَلْهَادِی الْمُهْتَدِیْ، اَلتَّقِیُّ النَّقِیُّ الزَّیُّ الرَّضِیُّ، فَاسْلُكْ بِنَا عَلٰی یَدَیْهِ مِنْهَاجَ الْهُدٰی، وَالْمَهَجَّۃَ الْعُظْمٰی، وَقَوِّنَا عَلٰی مُتَابَعَتِهٖ، وَاَدَائِ حَقِّهٖ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِیْ اَعْوَانِهٖ وَاَنْصَارِهٖ، اِنَّكَ سَمِیْعُ الدُّعَائِ۔

trans.en: O Allah, bless Mohammad and his holy Progeny. O Allah, we will bear witness on the day of Resurrection, on the day of great calamity, that they never committed any sin, and never disobeyed You, and never ignored Your obedience, and that our Master is the Master of time, the guide and the guided, the pious, the pure, the good and the favourite. Thus help us walk through the path of guidance and the evident path through him, and give us the ability to follow him, and to pay his rights, and resurrect us among his supporters and helpers, indeed You are the Hearer of supplication.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
